title: fix(console): keep FormPage's required `*` out of the control's accessible name
body:
Fixes #10178

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` renders the `/f/:slug` and `/forms/:name` routes.

- The required `*` inside each row's `label` is now `aria-hidden="true"`. A short comment cites objectui#3299, the rule `ActionParamDialog` already states beside its own marker: "Visual-only (objectui#3299): `aria-required` on the widget is the announced channel; hiding the `*` keeps it out of the control's accessible name."
- The checkbox arm (`boolean` / `toggle` / `checkbox`) now carries `aria-required` when the row is required. It was the one control this marker labels with no required channel at all, so hiding the `*` would otherwise have left nothing announcing the requirement. Native `required` is deliberately not used there: on a checkbox it means "must be checked", while the required rule this page reads (`isMissingForRequired` in `@object-ui/core`) counts `false` as a value, so the browser would block a submit the rule accepts.

Plus one pin, `apps/console/src/__tests__/formPageRequiredMarker-10178.test.tsx`, and one changeset (`@object-ui/console`: patch).

## Measured on main before the change (BASE `1f8ef0a89`)

The new pin against the unmodified `FormPage.tsx`: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`. Text control: expected accessible name `Title`, received `Title *`. Checkbox: received `Agree * Agree`.

Which controls carried a required channel on main. This is one render of every arm the switch spells, each field required, from a throwaway harness that is not committed:

| arm | control | required channel on main | accessible name on main | after this PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| text, textarea, number, currency, email, url, password, date, time, datetime, select | input / textarea / select | native `required` | `LABEL *` | `LABEL`; `required` unchanged |
| boolean, toggle, checkbox | checkbox input | none | `LABEL * LABEL` | `LABEL LABEL`; `aria-required="true"` |
| radio | radio inputs | none | the row label's `for` names no element | unchanged (see Acceptance notes) |
| file | shared `FileField` | `aria-required` already | not rendered in this harness | unchanged |

Real browser, same markup: the form the pin renders was dumped from the test DOM and loaded into headless Chromium 141 (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`). CDP accessibility-tree names on this branch: textbox `Title` (required=true), combobox `Kind`, checkbox `Agree Agree`. The same markup with the three marker `aria-hidden` attributes removed (the shape on main): `Title*`, `Kind*`, `Agree* Agree`.

## The pin

Four cases:

- A required text control is named exactly `Title`, reports `toBeRequired()`, and its marker is still drawn with `aria-hidden="true"`.
- A required checkbox has no `*` in its name, has `aria-required="true"`, and has no native `required`.
- Controls: an optional text control and an optional checkbox show no marker and report no requirement.

The checkbox name is asserted as "contains no `*`" rather than an exact string. The arm's own wrapping label duplicates the name, which is a separate defect (see Acceptance notes). Pinning the exact name would pin that defect.

## Reverse verification (the fix committed first, HEAD `532aaa8ba`)

1. `FormPage.tsx` checked out at BASE, so both halves are removed. Pin: `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`: the two required cases fail and the two controls stay green, as they should. Restored with a checkout from `HEAD`: blob `f34d6d767d96` equals the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
2. Only the checkbox `aria-required` line deleted, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor count 1 → 0). Pin: `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`, failing on `toHaveAttribute('aria-required', 'true')`. Restored: blob equals HEAD. A first attempt at this leg was a no-op that the tool refused, because its replacement string was a substring of the anchor and the count could not rise. It ran no test and is not counted.

## Gates, all at HEAD `532aaa8ba`

- The console package's whole test project, `pnpm exec vitest run --project @object-ui/console --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 110 passed (110)`, `Tests 1217 passed (1217)`. An earlier subset of the 25 test files that reference FormPage (300 tests) is included in that run.
- `eslint .` in `apps/console`, which is the package's own `lint` script that `pnpm lint` runs through turbo. The full package run, not narrowed: 214 files, 0 errors. `FormPage.tsx` has 21 warnings, the same 21 it has at BASE (linted from `git show`). The new test has 0.
- Console `type-check`: **NOT MEASURED.** Its `tsc --noEmit` resolves every `@object-ui/*` import through `dist/*.d.ts`, and that dependency closure (30+ packages) is unbuilt in this worktree. Building it does not fit the foreground cap. A narrower substitute reading, declared as one: `tsc --noEmit` under the console `tsconfig.json`, with `@object-ui/*` mapped to `packages/*/src` and `include` limited to the two touched `.tsx` files plus `vite-env.d.ts`. It reported 0 errors in either touched file. The 100 errors elsewhere are all in other packages' sources, which are not written for that mapping. Controls: a type error injected into `FormPage.tsx` surfaced as TS2322, and one injected into the test surfaced as TS2554, so both files were checked semantically. An earlier run that set `baseUrl` stopped on TS5101, an options diagnostic that suppresses semantic checking, so it is not counted.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` passed (1 released package, 1 changeset). `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` passed. `check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` printed `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`. `check-control-bytes.mjs`, `check-vi-mock-specifiers.mjs`, `check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs`, `check-vi-mock-override-shape.mjs` and `check-test-path-roots.mjs` all passed.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the three paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Acceptance notes

- **Checkbox in Chromium.** Chromium's CDP tree reports no `required` property for a checkbox under either channel. I measured native `required` and `aria-required` separately, and both were absent; textbox and radiogroup nodes do report it. So the checkbox half follows ARIA 1.2, where `aria-required` is a supported property of role checkbox, but I could not measure its announcement in this Chromium. The pin asserts the attribute.
- **Not in this card's class.** `SettingsField` (console) and `DatasourceResourcePage` (app-shell) draw a bare `*` inside a `Label` that has no `htmlFor` and wraps no control, so that `*` reaches no accessible name. I did not measure whether those controls get a name from anywhere else. Designer and preview rows (`ObjectFormCanvas`, `ObjectFormDesigner`, `DataModelDesigner`, `ActionPreview`), the column headers in `GridField` and in the metadata-admin `widgets.tsx` table (no control references them), and the `ImportWizard` option text are not a control's label either.
- **Out-of-scope defects** found while doing this, listed in the dispatch report for the seat to file and not changed here:
  - FormPage's checkbox arm renders two labels for one control, so its name reads `Agree Agree`.
  - FormPage's radio arm points the row label's `for` at an id no element carries, so the group has no name and no required state.
  - The same bare, not-hidden `*` in an associated label appears in app-shell `ScreenView` and `SchemaForm`, and in plugin-designer `AppCreationWizard`.
  - The CSS `after:content-['*']` marker used by `packages/components` form labels does enter the accessible name in Chromium, although the tests there assert under happy-dom that it does not.
  - objectui#10179 remains open. It is not addressed here, and this PR touches only the marker markup and the checkbox attribute.
